name: Clayton J. Lloyd International Airport

runway.v: one runway, 11/29, 1,664 m x 30 m; displaced thresholds: take-off run 1,516 m (11) / 1,514 m (29), landing distance 1,366 m both ways

notes: Read: AIRAC AIP SUP 24/26 (Eastern Caribbean AIP, TTCAA), dated 10 Jun 2026, effective 260709 to PERM, replacing SUP 29/24: aerodrome chart and data. It also states 'INSTRUMENT RESTRICTED BY NIGHT' and 'NUMEROUS POLES AND ANTENNAS IN VICINITY OF AERODROME'. Base Eastern Caribbean AIP is login-only (https://caa.gov.tt/eastern-caribbean-eaip/). Government of Anguilla airport page (https://www.gov.ai/ministry/micuhites-2/clayton-j-lloyd-international-airport) read: no hours, runway or customs. Note the short landing distance (1,366 m) limits larger jets.
